source_reference: Dalaisón-Fuentes et al. 2022, Pest Management Science 78(7):3108-3116
documented_features: Dmai-BicC was documented as an RNAi target in adult female Dalbulus maidis; silencing reduced transcript abundance and oviposition, and ovarian phenotypes showed altered oocyte development. The official Supporting Information identifies TRINITY_DN24799_c0_g1_i7 as the putative Dmai-BicC transcript, with a 2655 bp full-length cDNA encoding a predicted 778 amino acid protein.
notes: The Trinity transcript identifier and predicted cDNA and protein lengths are publication-local. No published protein identifier, public accession, or documented mapping to GITV00000000.1 was found. Stage 3 must resolve the anchor against the materialized TSA.
